title: Sunday pancakes
transcript: Okay so today we're making fluffy pancakes. You'll need one and a half cups of flour, three and a half teaspoons of baking powder, a tablespoon of sugar, a quarter teaspoon of salt, one and a quarter cups of milk, one egg and three tablespoons of melted butter. Whisk the dry ingredients together, then mix the wet ingredients in a separate bowl and pour into the dry. Stir until just combined, a few lumps are fine. Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat and pour about a quarter cup of batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip, and cook another minute or two. Makes about eight pancakes.
